site.description: Every tank for itself. Parachute in, grab the blinking power tiles, call airstrikes, dodge the mines. Most kills in three minutes wins.

page.lead: Every tank for itself. Parachute in, grab the blinking power tiles, call airstrikes and dodge the mines. Die, drop back in: most kills in three minutes wins. Play solo against bots, in a platoon, or two players online.

poster.alt: Battlefield Blitz mid-match: pixel tanks trade fire between orange cover blocks, with the kills and timer bar on top and the LONG, STRIKE, AUTO and LOCK keys bottom right

howToPlay.title: Pick a mode
howToPlay.body: Practice, Solo or Platoon on the start screen (it remembers your choice), or open the two-player lobby.

howToPlay.title: Drive and shoot
howToPlay.body: WASD or the arrows drive, the mouse aims, click or Space fires. Auto-aim starts on: Q toggles it and T locks onto one target.

howToPlay.title: Use the long gun
howToPlay.body: E or right-click fires the LONG gun: it locks on, then a guided round crosses the field, punches through cover and wrecks in one hit. You start with 3 long shots.

howToPlay.title: Call airstrikes
howToPlay.body: Press F, then click where the bombs go. A bomber flies in over your shoulder.

howToPlay.title: Grab tiles and win
howToPlay.body: Lit tiles give rapid fire, triple shot, shields, health, long shots and strikes; mines blow up whoever drives onto them. Most kills when the three minutes are up wins.

controls.title: Desktop
controls.body: WASD or arrows drive, the mouse aims, click or Space fires. E or right-click fires a long shot, F calls an airstrike on the next click, Q is auto-aim, T aim lock and Esc pauses.

controls.title: Phone
controls.body: Drag on the left half to drive and tap the field to shoot there. AUTO and LOCK ride on FIRE; LONG and STRIKE sit in a row above it.

controls.title: Move the keys
controls.body: The grab bar on top moves the whole pad. It is remembered, and a double-click puts it back.

controls.title: Pause
controls.body: Esc or the white flag: KEEP FIGHTING or SURRENDER.

modes.title: Practice
modes.body: No clock. Three TARGET tanks that stand still and three MOVERs that drive about, none of which shoot back, while a coach walks you through every control. Ammo and strikes never run out.

modes.title: Solo
modes.body: Eight tanks, every tank for itself. Most kills in three minutes wins.

modes.title: Platoon
modes.body: You and three wingmen in your colour against two other platoons of four. No friendly fire; the platoon with the most kills wins.

modes.title: Two players
modes.body: Two people, one match, each on their own screen. Join with an invite code and a room, send the link to player 2, and bots fill the other seats.

tips.title: Watch the heat
tips.body: The cannon fires fast but overheats if you hold it: watch the ring on FIRE.

tips.title: Kill streaks pay
tips.body: Kills in one life: 2 give a long shot, 3 an airstrike, 5 a carpet bomb and 8 a NUKE. A carpet bomb makes your next strike drop seven bombs.

tips.title: Chase the crates
tips.body: Supply crates parachute in every 20 seconds or so: a medkit, long ammo, an airstrike or the jackpot.

items.title: Two-player lobby
items.body: The two-player page is one full-screen stage with a join card: invite code, room and JOIN, then SEND LINK while you wait for player 2.

items.title: Rematch
items.body: After the result, REMATCH keeps both players in the same room with a fresh seed, or pick NEW ROOM.

items.title: Rejoin
items.body: If the other player leaves, REJOIN or NEW ROOM. Before, the match just waited.

items.title: The scoreboard drags
items.body: Drag the bar at the top to move the scoreboard. It stays on the board, is remembered on this device, and a double-click puts it back.

faq.q: How do two players play Battlefield Blitz?
faq.a: Open the two-player page on both devices and join the same room with the same invite code, or send the link from the lobby. After the countdown you play one match; bots fill the other seats.

faq.q: Is Battlefield Blitz free to play?
faq.a: Yes. It plays in your browser with no install, and it is open source (MIT).

faq.q: Can I put Battlefield Blitz on my own site?
faq.a: Yes. One script tag adds a PLAY BLITZ key to any page, and the page itself becomes the arena. Escape gives it back exactly as it was.

faq.q: How is it related to DOM Battlefield?
faq.a: It is the arcade version of DOM Battlefield, with the same Battlefield brand and Board UI keys. It runs on the Fizlet engine and draws Sherman Bytes' tank sprites.
